name: 7Labs Debug & Branding for Commerce7
author: DMitru.com

sections.description:
7Labs Debug & Branding for Commerce7 helps you spot storefront problems, tidy the shop experience, and match Commerce7 to your brand — free forever.

Empty-looking shop, off-brand buttons, messy layouts, or unsure if you’re ready to send traffic? Built for wineries, breweries, and DTC brands on WordPress (Elementor or block themes):

  • Match buttons, colors, fonts, and cart styling to your brand (Brand Kit + live preview)
  • Catch theme vs shop mismatches and weak contrast (Visual Match)
  • See shop health at a glance — score, status cards, and clear next steps
  • Fix broken Shop / menu links and common page conflicts (Elementor, cart, checkout, club)
  • Run Site QA and Pre-Launch checks before campaigns
  • Optional setup wizard: scan → recommended fixes → design preset in a few minutes

An independent 7Labs plugin for Commerce7 storefronts on WordPress. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Commerce7.

Features

  • Brand Kit — colors, fonts, cart tone, presets, live preview, export/import
  • Visual Match — theme vs shop style report and button contrast checks
  • Dashboard — health score, status cards, and Quick Fix when you want a fast pass
  • Setup wizard — guided scan, recommended fixes, and branding presets
  • Shop routes — point Shop at the collection customers should land on
  • Menus & content — find and fix empty or broken shop links (including Elementor)
  • Conflicts — required pages, permalinks, Elementor warnings, subfolder installs
  • Site QA & Pre-Launch — live diagnostics and a campaign-ready checklist

Free forever

Every tool in this plugin stays free. There is no Pro tier. Get Help lists optional white-glove setup packages you can book — never required.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • A Commerce7 storefront on your WordPress site

Privacy

Settings stay in your WordPress database. The plugin does not phone home. Optional service and guide links go to 7Labs-owned pages. If you load Google Fonts from Design, your site may request fonts from Google.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate 7Labs Debug & Branding for Commerce7.
  3. Open the plugin in wp-admin and follow the setup wizard (or go straight to the dashboard).
  4. Start with Brand Kit / Visual Match, or run Quick Fix if shop links need a fast cleanup.
sections.faq:
Who makes this plugin?

7Labs (Dmitru). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Commerce7.

What can I brand?

Buttons, text, fonts, forms/blocks, and cart badge styling — with scopes, presets, and a live preview so you can see changes before you save.

What does the health score cover?

Shop setup, menus/links, branding readiness, conflicts, and launch checks — so you know what to fix next without digging through settings blind.

What does Quick Fix change?

A fast recommended pass for shop collection targeting, continue-shopping, and broken menu cleanup. You can review everything on the dashboard afterward.

Will it break my Elementor pages?

It flags common conflicts (for example Elementor on cart/checkout/club) and helps clean empty shop links. It does not rebuild your Elementor templates.

Is the plugin free?

Yes — forever. Optional setup packages on Get Help are never required.

Is any data sent to 7Labs?

No. Settings stay on your site. Only if you click optional guide or booking links do you leave WordPress for 7Labs pages.
